THEKINGSDECREE-KINGS_SERVANT.title: The King's Servant
THEKINGSDECREE-KINGS_SERVANT.pages.INITI:
A cloaked figure steps from the shadows, blocking your path. He bows deeply — a servant of the [purple]King[/purple].

[sine][gold]"I have been sent to find those who have proven themselves."[/gold][/sine]

He produces a small wooden box. Inside, upon [b]velvet[/b], rests a [gold]ring[/gold] of [purple]ancient[/purple] make.

[sine][gold]"Only the worthy may claim what the King offers. But all may pay tribute."[/gold][/sine]
THEKINGSDECREE-KINGS_SERVANT.pages.ACCEP:
You reach into the box and slide the ring onto your finger. A surge of [purple]power[/purple] courses through you.

The servant nods.

[sine][gold]"The King's gift is not given lightly. May it serve you well."[/gold][/sine]

He bows once more and vanishes into the shadows.
THEKINGSDECREE-KINGS_SERVANT.pages.OFFER:
You draw a blade across your palm. [jitter][red]Blood[/red][/jitter] drips onto the stone floor.

The servant watches without expression. As the pain subsides, clarity washes over you — a technique you once struggled with now feels [b]effortless[/b].

[sine][gold]"The King accepts your offering."[/gold][/sine]
THEKINGSDECREE-KINGS_SERVANT.pages.DECLI:
You lower your gaze. The servant's eyes soften briefly.

[sine][gold]"Your humility grants you mercy. But what you have not earned, I shall take back."[/gold][/sine]

A [green]warmth[/green] washes through you as a [purple]technique you once mastered[/purple] slips from your grasp. The servant is gone.
THEKINGSDECREE-KINGS_THRONE_ROOM.title: The King's Throne Room
THEKINGSDECREE-KINGS_THRONE_ROOM.pages.I:
You step through an archway of [purple]ancient stone[/purple] into a vast throne room. Pillars of [b]obsidian[/b] rise toward a ceiling lost in shadow.

Upon a throne of [sine][gold]black iron[/gold][/sine] sits the King — ageless, silent, [jitter]watching[/jitter].

His gaze falls upon you like a weight. He speaks without moving his lips.

[sine][gold]"You stand before the King. What do you seek?"[/gold][/sine]
Replace [gold]Mardan Fu Mardan's Ring[/gold] with [gold]Sultan's Ring[/gold]. Gain [gold]King's Curse[/gold].
Remove [red]{Cards}[/red] random non-starting cards. Choose a [gold]Rare[/gold] card from any class.
Requires at least [blue]{Cards}[/blue] non-starting cards in your [gold]Deck[/gold].
THEKINGSDECREE-KINGS_THRONE_ROOM.pages.C:
The King [jitter][b]rises[/b][/jitter]. The room [jitter][red]trembles[/red][/jitter].

[sine][gold]"So it is you."[/gold][/sine]

He extends a hand — and the ring on your finger [jitter]shifts[/jitter], its form reforged by [orange]invisible fire[/orange] into something older, something [purple]greater[/purple].

But as the new ring settles, a [red]cold ache[/red] spreads through your chest.

The King sits.
[sine][gold]"Power has its price. You know this."[/gold][/sine]
THEKINGSDECREE-KINGS_THRONE_ROOM.pages.B:
You kneel. The King watches, [purple]unmoved[/purple].

[sine][gold]"Gold is the simplest desire. So be it."[/gold][/sine]

A [jitter][gold]cascade of coins[/gold][/jitter] spills from the darkness behind the throne. But as you gather them, a [jitter][red]sharp pain[/red][/jitter] lances through your heart.

[sine][gold]"The King's generosity always comes at a price."[/gold][/sine]
THEKINGSDECREE-KINGS_THRONE_ROOM.pages.A:
[sine][gold]"Power demands sacrifice,"[/gold][/sine] the King intones.

Cards lift from your deck unbidden, dissolving into [purple]motes of light[/purple]. In their place, knowledge of a [gold]rare and potent technique[/gold] settles into your mind.

[sine][gold]"Use it wisely. There will be no second gift."[/gold][/sine]
THEKINGSDECREE-KINGS_THRONE_ROOM.pages.E:
You step forward and perform — a tale, a trick, a display of skill.

The King's eyes flicker with the faintest spark of interest. He raises a single finger.

[sine][gold]"...Amusing."[/gold][/sine]

With a flick of his wrist, he banishes a burden from your [gold]Deck[/gold].

You step forward and perform — a tale, a trick, a display of skill.

The King watches in [purple]silence[/purple], his expression [sine]unmoved[/sine]. When you finish, his only response is a slow, weighted exhale.

A wave of [jitter][red]crushing humiliation[/red][/jitter] washes over you. You have dared to entertain the King — and failed.
